item.title: Dynamic plasma, two-dimensional, with priced embedded calls
item.body:
Replace the 100-block-per-momentum count with a priced budget that admits rollup-shaped
data, cannot wedge an account, and charges embedded-contract calls for the bytes they
carry (roadmap M2).

- A data dimension and an execution dimension, each with its own 1559-style target
- Replace-by-plasma as a consensus rule, not a per-node policy
- Eight weeks of public-testnet soak, then one spork together with libp2p
item.author: dev-ada
